description: Registry of vetted wildfire, fire, smoke, and neutral computer vision datasets for SCOUT Milestone 07 Phase 7B expansion.

dfire.name: D-Fire: An Image Dataset for Fire and Smoke Detection
curators: Pedro Vinícius Almeida Borges de Venâncio
dfire.institution: GAIA Solutions on Demand / Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais (UFMG)
dfire.citation: Borges de Venâncio, P. V. A., & Lisboa, A. C. (2022). D-Fire: An image dataset for fire and smoke detection. Gaia Solutions on Demand.

risk_assessment.leakage_notes: Surveillance videos contain temporal frame sequences; must enforce strict scene-grouping before split generation.

bowfire.name: BoWFire Dataset: Fire and Non-Fire Still Image Benchmark
bowfire.institution: GBDI - ICMC - University of São Paulo (USP), Brazil

license.name: Academic Research & Non-Commercial License (Flickr Attribution Required)
license.redistribution_notes: BoWFireDataset README.txt explicitly restricts public redistribution of raw images without individual Flickr permissions. Raw image binaries are strictly for internal project research and evaluation; public releases must fetch images via automated download scripts.

bowfire.citation: Chino, D. Y., Avalhais, L. P., Rodrigues, J. F., & Traina, A. J. (2015). BoWFire: Detection of Fire in Still Images by Integrating Pixel Color and Texture Analysis. SIBGRAPI 2015.
modalities: adversarial/distractor non-fire scenes (sunsets, autumn leaves, red vehicles)

risk_assessment.leakage_notes: Diverse standalone still images; low temporal autocorrelation.
risk_assessment.format_bias_notes: Contains non-fire JPEG and PNG images; excellent for breaking format confounding.

fasdd.name: FASDD: An Open-Access 100,000-Level Flame and Smoke Detection Dataset
fasdd.institution: School of Remote Sensing and Information Engineering, Wuhan University
fasdd.citation: Wang, M., Yue, P., Jiang, L., Yu, D., Tuo, T., & Li, J. (2025). An open flame and smoke detection dataset for deep learning in remote sensing based fire detection. Geo-spatial Information Science, 28(2), 511-526. DOI: 10.1080/10095020.2024.2347922

risk_assessment.leakage_notes: UAV and CV video captures contain densely sampled consecutive frames. Video sequence ID tracking is strictly required.

flame.name: FLAME: Fire Detection and Modeling Aerial Multi-Spectral Dataset
flame.institution: AI-SENDS Lab, Clemson University / Northern Arizona University
flame.citation: Mostafapour, A., Chen, X., & Razi, A. (2021). FLAME: Fire Detection and Modeling: Aerial Multi-Spectral Image Dataset. IEEE DataPort. DOI: 10.1109/ACCESS.2021.3134674

risk_assessment.leakage_notes: Continuous UAV flight videos over prescribed burns. Frames within same flight session must remain clustered.

figlib.name: HPWREN FIgLib: Fire Ignition Library
figlib.institution: San Diego Supercomputer Center / UC San Diego
figlib.citation: Braun, H. W., & Vernon, F. (2016). High Performance Wireless Research and Education Network (HPWREN) Fire Ignition Library. UC San Diego. DOI: 10.26022/IEDA/330043
modalities: Mountaintop PTZ fixed optical surveillance cameras (Southern California)

risk_assessment.leakage_notes: Time-lapse intervals (typically 1 frame per minute) from fixed camera coordinates. High temporal and spatial background autocorrelation.

deepquest_v1.name: DeepQuestAI Fire-Smoke Dataset (SCOUT v1 Reused Historical Cohort)
deepquest_v1.cohort_notes: The 2,931 images marked deepquest_v1 in fire_smoke_v2 are directly reused from historical fire_smoke_v1 (100% bitwise SHA-256 parity). They were not independently re-downloaded from the external web repository.
deepquest_v1.citation: Olafenwa, M. (2019). Fire-Smoke-Dataset: A dataset of images for fire and smoke classification. DeepQuest AI.

risk_assessment.leakage_notes: Existing split in v1 contains near-duplicate web images, resolved via dHash scene grouping.
risk_assessment.format_bias_notes: In v1, 100% of test neutral images were 800x600 PackBits TIFFs while fire/smoke were JPEGs. In v2, format balancing reduces Cramér's V from 1.0 to 0.244 in test, but residual confounding persists.
risk_assessment.residual_confounding_notes: 100% of smoke images remain JPEG (1,144/1,144); 100% of TIFF images remain exclusive to neutral (156/156); PNG is present in fire (120) and neutral (109) but 0 in smoke. Split is group-independent (0 leaked scene groups), not source-independent.

fismo.name: FiSmo: Emergency Situation Dataset for Fire and Smoke
fismo.citation: Avalhais, L. P., Chino, D. Y., Traina, A. J. (2018). FiSmo: A compilation of fire and smoke images for emergency analysis. ICMC-USP.

risk_assessment.leakage_notes: Standalone emergency photos; low frame-to-frame leakage.
